items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: Jimmie wasn't very friendly. ... I used to love to see Jimmie play.

ctx.x: You know, it's like home base. They'd say hey, can you rehearse at the union. So Duke actually rehearsed there, and possibly Jimmie Lunceford?
Yeah, Duke did. He was there, and Jimmie Lunceford.
Sure. That's what I mean, this would possibly happen.
